nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged owner address, written from msg.sender in constructor and in _transferOwnership.
CHOAM.master: address receiving protocol fees via master.transfer(price).
CHOAM.inited: one-time init guard set inside init().
CHOAM.koef: global price divisor used in fee/price divisions.
CHOAM.create_flag: toggles triple planet creation inside buy_planet().
CHOAM.silo: accumulated silo fee paid out on expiry.
CHOAM.silo_addr: current silo beneficiary.
CHOAM.silo_timer: timestamp deadline compared against now.
CHOAM.players: mapping(address=>Player) holding balances, positions and planet lists.
CHOAM.nodes: array of linked-list Node structs holding Planet data.
Constant base planet price (1e17 wei).
Constant fee range used to derive pseudo-random planet fee.
Constant minimum planet fee.
Constant silo fee contribution.
Constant seconds added to silo_timer per purchase.
Constant page size used in paginated view functions.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner).
Only-owner function clearing owner and emitting OwnershipRenounced.
Only-owner entrypoint forwarding to _transferOwnership.
Internal ownership transfer with non-zero address check.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with assert overflow check.
SafeMath.div: unchecked integer division.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add: addition with assert(c >= a).
CHOAM constructor: master = msg.sender.
Only-owner one-time initialization creating 12 planets.
Payable fallback that forwards to buy_spice_melange().
Paginated view of caller-owned planets, indexed by msg.sender.
Only-owner setter for master address with non-zero check.
Only-owner setter for koef, requires > 0.
View returning PLANET_PRICE/koef + FEE_SILO/koef.
View returning planet fee/data/owner/prev/next for an id.
View iterating the planet list and exposing silo metadata and remaining timer.
View of caller player state plus discounted planet price.
Private planet factory using blockhash-derived hash for fee and insertion index.
Payable: tx.origin-gated balance top-up; initializes player position from a blockhash hash.
tx.origin-gated withdrawal using low-level msg.sender.send(amount).
tx.origin-gated loop traversing the linked list, paying fees to planet owners.
tx.origin-gated single-step variant of move().
tx.origin-gated purchase that mutates ownership, silo state and transfers price to master.
View returning nodes.length.
Private linked-list insertion pushing into nodes array.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for identity, ownership and payout.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time driving silo_timer logic.
tx.origin: used as an anti-contract gate on all economic entrypoints.
Unsafe low-level external ETH send: msg.sender.send(amount) in sell_spice_melange.
External ETH transfer master.transfer(price) with state-mutated balance accounting.
Arithmetic on balances/price (add/sub/mul/div) whose safety depends on SafeMath only for uint256 ops.
Timestamp dependency: comparisons with now/silo_timer control silo payouts.
Pseudo-randomness from blockhash(11) + msg.sender + nodes.length to derive fees and positions.
amount parameter of sell_spice_melange, bounded by player balance.
id local in move(): current linked-list cursor.
fee local in move(): fee paid to the visited planet owner.
price local in buy_planet(): discounted planet price.
hash local in create_planet(): blockhash-derived entropy for fee and index.
id local in buy_planet(): target node index from player position.
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
page parameter of get_owner_planets for pagination offset.
_koef parameter of set_koef, must be > 0.
adr parameter of set_master, must be non-zero.
node memory struct built in insert() before push.
i loop counter in get_info().
hash local in buy_spice_melange(): blockhash-derived initial position.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to Ownable.owner in the constructor.
msg.sender is assigned to master in the CHOAM constructor.
players mapping is keyed and mutated by msg.sender in every economic entrypoint.
silo_timer is set from now during buy_planet silo accounting.
now feeds the timestamp-dependent silo payout condition.
get_info compares now with silo_timer to expose remaining time.
buy_planet branches on now < silo_timer to decide silo payout vs reset.
buy_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
sell_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
move requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
step requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
buy_planet requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
Ownable constructor writes owner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable.
CHOAM constructor initializes master.
Payable fallback directly invokes buy_spice_melange.
init() calls create_planet twelve times.
create_planet calls insert to append a node.
buy_planet conditionally calls create_planet three times via create_flag.
buy_planet performs external master.transfer(price) after state changes.
sell_spice_melange executes msg.sender.send(amount) after balance deduction.
buy_spice_melange adds msg.value into players[msg.sender].balance.
move updates player balances and position in the players mapping.
step updates player balances and position in the players mapping.
buy_planet updates balances, planet lists, discounts and silo payouts.
buy_planet assigns nodes[id].planet.owner = msg.sender.
create_planet reads nodes.length to derive the fee and insertion index.
insert pushes the new node and rewires prev/next pointers in nodes.
price/balance add-sub-mul-div arithmetic performed through SafeMath in buy_planet.
move performs balance sub/add fee transfers that must not overflow.
step performs balance sub/add fee transfers that must not overflow.
create_planet derives fee and index from blockhash(11)-based entropy.
buy_spice_melange derives the initial position from blockhash(11)-based entropy.
msg.sender.send(amount) hands control to the caller address before returning.
master.transfer(price) transfers control/value to an address controlled by the owner flow.
master receives the ETH fee transferred from buy_planet.
msg.sender is the recipient of the unsafe low-level send in sell_spice_melange.
msg.sender-controlled master receives the transferred planet price.
amount parameter drives the balance deduction in sell_spice_melange.
amount is forwarded to the unsafe external send.
id cursor is walked through the nodes linked list in move.
fee derived from nodes[id] is subtracted from the mover balance in move.
price computed from PLANET_PRICE/koef/discount is deducted in buy_planet.
hash determines the new planet fee and insertion index.
id selects the node to purchase and mutate ownership for.
_newOwner flows into transferOwnership and ultimately the owner state variable.
page parameter computes the pagination offset via mul(PAGE_SIZE).
_koef is validated and written into the koef state variable.
adr is validated and written into the master state variable.
node memory struct is pushed into the nodes array in insert.
loop counter i indexes the get_info output arrays and list traversal.
hash sets players[msg.sender].position on first deposit.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent security role outside sell_spice_melange, so it is merged into that function node.
The id cursor is a transient list-walking local fully contained in move().
The fee local exists only to compute the balance transfer inside move().
The price local is derived and consumed entirely within buy_planet().
The blockhash-derived hash local only feeds fee/index computation in create_planet().
The id local is the purchase target inside buy_planet() and has no external role.
The _newOwner parameter is the sole input of the ownership transfer flow.
The page parameter only computes the pagination offset in get_owner_planets().
The _koef parameter is validated and stored only through set_koef().
The adr parameter is validated and stored only through set_master().
The node memory struct is a construction local used only for the array push in insert().
The i counter only controls the bounded loop inside get_info().
The hash local only derives the initial player position inside buy_spice_melange().
